# Shipping

Standard delivery costs £3.95 and arrives in three to five working days.
Orders over £50 ship free.

Express delivery costs £8.50 and arrives the next working day when the order
is placed before noon. We dispatch from Leeds on weekdays only, so a Saturday
order leaves on Monday.

We ship to the UK, Ireland and the Channel Islands. Tracking numbers are
emailed as soon as the parcel leaves the warehouse.
